stories.title: US-Migrationspolitik: US-Regierung darf Migranten vorerst wieder in Drittstaaten abschieben

en.title: US Migration Policy: US Government Permitted to Temporarily Resume Deporting Migrants to Third Countries
en.summary: The Supreme Court has allowed the Trump administration to proceed with deporting migrants to third countries, suspending a lower court ruling that had blocked the practice.

stories.title: Nations League: England siegt souverän – Yamal trifft doppelt

en.title: Nations League: England Wins Decisively – Yamal Scores Twice
en.summary: England defeated Czech Republic under coach Thomas Tuchel, providing relief from domestic media pressure. Spain also won their Nations League match.

stories.title: Nations League: Tuchel siegt souverän mit England - Yamal erzielt Doppelpack

en.title: Nations League: Tuchel Wins Decisively with England - Yamal Scores Double
en.summary: England achieved a decisive victory in Nations League play with Yamal scoring two goals in the match.

stories.title: Regierungsbildung in Sachsen-Anhalt: AfD-Kandidat Siegmund will Ministerpräsident werden

en.title: Government Formation in Saxony-Anhalt: AfD Candidate Siegmund Seeks to Become Minister-President
en.summary: An AfD candidate named Siegmund is seeking the position of minister-president in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt during government formation negotiations.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Oberster Gerichtshof erlaubt vorerst wieder Abschiebungen in Drittstaaten

en.title: USA News Blog: Supreme Court temporarily allows deportations to third countries again
en.summary: The US Supreme Court has temporarily permitted the government to resume deporting individuals to countries that are not their home without allowing them to lodge objections. The legal dispute over this practice continues following a provisional victory for President Trump.

stories.title: USA: Supreme Court erlaubt vorerst wieder Abschiebungen in Drittstaaten

en.title: USA: Supreme Court temporarily allows deportations to third countries again
en.summary: The US Supreme Court has provisionally decided to allow the government to continue deporting migrants to third countries. An oral hearing on the matter is scheduled to take place.

stories.title: Manchester City: Geschäftsführer wirft Premier League »Verschwörungstheorien« vor

en.title: Manchester City: Executive accuses Premier League of "conspiracy theories"
en.summary: The Premier League has found Manchester City guilty of serious financial regulation violations. The club has responded to the ruling with strong language criticizing the league.

stories.title: Premier League spricht Manchester City in Finanzaffäre schuldig

en.title: Premier League finds Manchester City guilty in financial affair
en.summary: The Premier League has officially stated that Manchester City systematically violated financial rules through sham contracts, obscuring approximately one billion euros in costs. The club faces potential severe sanctions.

stories.title: Berliner Linken-Fraktionschefin Eralp war Mitglied der "Roten Hilfe"

en.title: Berlin Left Party faction leader Eralp was member of 'Red Help'
en.summary: The faction leader of Berlin's Left Party held passive membership in Red Help, an organization providing legal support to left-wing activists and classified as left-extremist by German security authorities.

stories.title: Bundeswehr: Neuer Marinehafen soll offenbar in Emden entstehen

en.title: Bundeswehr: New naval port to reportedly be established in Emden
en.summary: Germany's Navy is expected to gain a second dedicated port facility on the North Sea coast in addition to its existing one in Wilhelmshaven, with Emden apparently selected as the location.

stories.title: Newsblog zu den Landtagswahlen: Eralp war Mitglied der linksextremistischen „Roten Hilfe“

en.title: State election news blog: Eralp was member of left-extremist 'Red Aid'
en.summary: A Berlin election winner is reported to have joined the left-extremist organization Red Aid as a law student, which is monitored by the domestic intelligence agency.

stories.title: Linke - Berlin: Elif Eralp war Mitglied im linksextremen Verein Rote Hilfe e.V.

en.title: Left - Berlin: Elif Eralp was a member of the far-left organization Rote Hilfe e.V.
en.summary: Elif Eralp, who aims to become Berlin's governing mayor, was previously a member of Rote Hilfe, an organization monitored by the German domestic intelligence agency.

stories.title: Nordafrika: In Marokko übernimmt erstmals eine Frau die Regierungsspitze

en.title: North Africa: Woman takes government leadership in Morocco for first time
en.summary: Fatima Ezzahra el-Mansouri, age 50, became Morocco's first female prime minister and must now form a governing coalition as her country prepares to co-host a major international event.

stories.title: Anleihen: Rendite von 30-jährigen US-Bonds so hoch wie zuletzt 2002 – „Spielraum für weitere Zinsanstiege“

en.title: Bonds: Yield on 30-year US bonds as high as last in 2002 – "room for further rate increases"
en.summary: Yields on US Treasury bonds have climbed to levels not seen since 2002, with analysts from a major US bank suggesting potential for continued upward movement in rates.

stories.title: Fußball: Premier League spricht Man City in Finanz-Affäre schuldig

en.title: Football: Premier League finds Man City guilty in financial affair
en.summary: Manchester City has been found guilty of violating financial regulations. The club now faces severe penalties.

stories.title: Tech-Konzern: Neuer Apple-Chef plant offenbar weitreichenden Konzernumbau

en.title: Tech Conglomerate: New Apple CEO Apparently Plans Sweeping Company Restructuring
en.summary: Apple CEO John Ternus is reportedly planning extensive restructuring efforts within the company. The changes focus on management levels and the integration of artificial intelligence.
